segments.text: This is NEWS IN 60. I'm Sam Night.

Smartphone battery breakthrough promises a week of use. Researchers at a battery firm say a new silicon design could let phones last a week between charges. The company hopes to start production in 2027, Circuit Weekly reports.
segments.headline: Smartphone battery breakthrough promises a week of use

segments.text: Seoul has started testing self-driving buses on two night routes, according to Circuit Weekly. The city says the buses will help night workers get home when other transport has stopped.
segments.headline: Seoul tests self-driving buses on night routes

segments.text: Around the world. First, Wales. Ancient footprints found on a beach in Wales, Starfield Journal reports.
segments.headline: Ancient footprints found on a beach in Wales

segments.text: Telescope in Chile spots water vapour on a distant planet, according to Starfield Journal.
segments.headline: Telescope in Chile spots water vapour on a distant planet

segments.text: A new pair of earbuds can translate conversations in 40 languages in real time, its maker says. “Travel should not stop at the language barrier,” the company said.
segments.headline: Translation earbuds now handle 40 languages

quote.text: Travel should not stop at the language barrier

segments.text: A Mars rover has photographed layered rocks in what scientists believe was an ancient lake bed. The layers could hold clues about past water on the planet, Starfield Journal reports.
segments.headline: Rover finds layered rocks in an ancient lake bed on Mars

segments.text: That's the minute. Stay with us on GLOBIT 24.
